rows.label: PRIZE
rows.clue: Something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery

rows.label: CASH FLOW
rows.clue: The excess of cash revenues over cash outlays in a give period of time (not including non-cash expenses)

rows.label: RATES
rows.clue: A local tax on property (usually used in the plural)

rows.label: TREASURY
rows.clue: The funds of a government or institution or individual

rows.label: LUMP SUM
rows.clue: A complete payment consisting of a single sum of money

rows.label: MORTGAGE
rows.clue: A conditional conveyance of property as security for the repayment of a loan

rows.label: FOUND
rows.clue: Food and lodging provided in addition to money

rows.label: TIME NOTE
rows.clue: A note that specifies the time (or times) of repayment

rows.label: TRADE GAP
rows.clue: The difference in value over a period of time of a country's imports and exports of merchandise

rows.label: RANSOM
rows.clue: Money demanded for the return of a captured person

rows.label: HOLE CARD
rows.clue: Any assets that are concealed until they can be used advantageously

rows.label: TRUST
rows.clue: Something (as property) held by one party (the trustee) for the benefit of another (the beneficiary)

rows.label: THINGS
rows.clue: Any movable possession (especially articles of clothing)

rows.label: PAY
rows.clue: Something that remunerates

rows.label: SHARE
rows.clue: Assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group

rows.label: DOLE
rows.clue: A share of money or food or clothing that has been charitably given

rows.label: PREMIUM
rows.clue: Payment for insurance

rows.label: TANNER
rows.clue: A small coin of the United Kingdom worth six pennies

rows.label: MERIT PAY
rows.clue: Extra pay awarded to an employee on the basis of merit (especially to school teachers)

rows.label: DRAFT
rows.clue: A document ordering the payment of money

rows.label: GIFT
rows.clue: Something acquired without compensation

rows.label: DEBIT
rows.clue: An accounting entry acknowledging sums that are owing

rows.label: STAMP TAX
rows.clue: A tax collected by requiring a stamp to be purchased and attached (usually on documents or publications)

rows.label: LEGAL FEE
rows.clue: A fee paid for legal service

rows.label: SAVINGS
rows.clue: A fund of money put by as a reserve

rows.label: PAWN
rows.clue: An article deposited as security

rows.label: HEIRLOOM
rows.clue: (law) any property that is considered by law or custom as inseparable from an inheritance is inherited with that inheritance

rows.label: EFFECTS
rows.clue: Property of a personal character that is portable but not used in business

rows.label: SALES
rows.clue: Income (at invoice values) received for goods and services over some given period of time

rows.label: SALES TAX
rows.clue: A tax based on the cost of the item purchased and collected directly from the buyer

rows.label: CAPITAL
rows.clue: Assets available for use in the production of further assets

rows.label: BUY
rows.clue: An advantageous purchase

rows.label: FINE
rows.clue: Money extracted as a penalty

rows.label: DONATION
rows.clue: A voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause

rows.label: BANK RATE
rows.clue: The discount rate fixed by a central bank

rows.label: FUNDING
rows.clue: Financial resources provided to make some project possible

rows.label: DIVIDEND
rows.clue: That part of the earnings of a corporation that is distributed to its shareholders

rows.label: CASH
rows.clue: Money in the form of bills or coins

rows.label: PROPERTY
rows.clue: Something owned

rows.label: EXCISE
rows.clue: A tax that is measured by the amount of business done (not on property or income from real estate)

rows.label: BAD CHECK
rows.clue: A check that is dishonored on presentation because of insufficient funds

rows.label: TARIFF
rows.clue: A government tax on imports or exports

rows.label: POSTAGE
rows.clue: The charge for mailing something

rows.label: SLICE
rows.clue: A share of something

rows.label: ROYALTY
rows.clue: Payment to the holder of a patent or copyright or resource for the right to use their property

rows.label: ALIMONY
rows.clue: Court-ordered support paid by one spouse to another after they are separated

rows.label: HOARD
rows.clue: A secret store of valuables or money

rows.label: LEVY
rows.clue: A charge imposed and collected

rows.label: AUDIT
rows.clue: An inspection of the accounting procedures and records by a trained accountant or CPA

rows.label: RESOURCE
rows.clue: Available source of wealth

rows.label: INCOME
rows.clue: The financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time

rows.label: FOOD BANK
rows.clue: A place where food is contributed and made available to those in need

rows.label: SEED CORN
rows.clue: Good quality seeds (as kernels of corn) that are reserved for planting

rows.label: CUSTOMS
rows.clue: Money collected under a tariff

rows.label: PEANUTS
rows.clue: An insignificant sum of money

rows.label: CASH CARD
rows.clue: A credit card that entitles the holder to receive cash

rows.label: ASSETS
rows.clue: Anything of material value or usefulness that is owned by a person or company

rows.label: BUDGET
rows.clue: A sum of money allocated for a particular purpose
